properties.name: gh pr edit fails with a "Projects (classic) is being deprecated" GraphQL error and changes NOTHING; the REST PATCH works
properties.statement: Measured 2026-09-12, twice: `gh pr edit <n> --body-file …` on this repo dies with a fatal GraphQL error about Projects (classic) and leaves the PR body untouched (body length verified unchanged after both attempts) — so a PR body "updated" this way is silently the old one. What works: `gh api -X PATCH repos/sligara7/reflow2/pulls/<n> --input -` with `{"body": "..."}` on stdin, then read the body back and check for a sentence you know is in the new text. Also on 2026-09-12: a `gh pr create --body-file /dev/stdin <<'X'` heredoc nested inside another heredoc swallowed the PR body into the COMMIT MESSAGE; write the body to a file first and pass the path. Moved here from an agent's machine-local memory file (rule:a-rule-the-project-follows-lives-in-the-graph-not-in-an-agents-memory).
